result.type: ∀ {n : ℕ}, (fun x => Real.log x ^ n) =o[Filter.atTop] id
result.value:
:= by
  rw [Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff_tendsto']
  · simpa using tendsto_pow_log_div_mul_add_atTop 1 0 n one_ne_zero
  filter_upwards [eventually_ne_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with x h₁ h₂ using (h₁ h₂).elim
result.informal_name: Logarithm Power is Little-o of Identity at Infinity
result.informal_description: For any natural number $n$, the function $(\log x)^n$ is asymptotically negligible compared to the identity function $x$ as $x \to \infty$, i.e., $(\log x)^n = o(x)$ with respect to the filter at top.

name: isBigO_rpow_top_log_smul
result.signature:
[NormedSpace ℝ E] {a b : ℝ} {f : ℝ → E} (hab : b < a) (hf : f =O[atTop] (· ^ (-a))) :
  (fun t : ℝ => log t • f t) =O[atTop] (· ^ (-b))
result.type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] {a b : ℝ} {f : ℝ → E},
  b < a → (f =O[Filter.atTop] fun x => x ^ (-a)) → (fun t => Real.log t • f t) =O[Filter.atTop] fun x => x ^ (-b)
result.value:
:=
  by
  refine
    ((isLittleO_log_rpow_atTop (sub_pos.mpr hab)).isBigO.smul hf).congr' (Eventually.of_forall fun t => by rfl)
      ((eventually_gt_atTop 0).mp (Eventually.of_forall fun t ht => ?_))
  simp only
  rw [smul_eq_mul, ← rpow_add ht, ← sub_eq_add_neg, sub_eq_add_neg a, add_sub_cancel_left]
result.informal_name: Big O Estimate with Logarithmic Factor for Real Power Functions
result.informal_description: Let $ E $ be a normed vector space over $ \mathbb{R} $. For real numbers $ a, b $ with $ b < a $, if a function $ f : \mathbb{R} \to E $ satisfies $ f(t) = O(t^{-a}) $ as $ t \to \infty $, then the function $ t \mapsto \log t \cdot f(t) $ satisfies $ O(t^{-b}) $ as $ t \to \infty $. Here, $ \log t $ denotes the natural logarithm of $ t $, and scalar multiplication $ \cdot $ acts on the normed space $ E $.
